I now have a thorough understanding of the entire codebase. Here is my complete report.

---

## Tutors-Apps Codebase Analysis

### 1. Project Structure

This is **not a monorepo with workspaces**. It is a single SvelteKit application at version **15.2.0**, named `"tutors"`. There are no npm/pnpm workspaces, no `packages/` directory, and no Turborepo or Lerna configuration.

**Top-level layout:**
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\` -- Main SvelteKit application source
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\cli\` -- A standalone CLI tool (`tutors-publish-npm`, compiled JS only, no source)
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\static\` -- Static assets (fonts, images, CSS)
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\.tessl\` -- Tessl AI tool documentation tiles (library docs cache)
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\.github\` -- Only CODEOWNERS and holopin.yml (no CI workflows)

**Total source code:** approximately 8,377 lines across all `.svelte` and `.ts` files.

**Git repository:** 3,225 total commits. The current branch is `feat/jupyter-notebook-support`. The upstream remote points at `tutors-sdk`. CODEOWNERS are `@edeleastar` and `@jouwdan`.

### 2. Application Architecture (SvelteKit Routes)

The app uses SvelteKit's **route groups** to organize three major sections:

**`(home)` -- Landing/Home page** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(home)\`)
- `+page.svelte` -- Shows a welcome banner, info, links, and a CourseList
- Sub-components: `CourseList.svelte`, `CourseVisitCard.svelte`, `Links.svelte`, `TutorsInfo.svelte`, `Welcome.svelte`

**`(course-reader)` -- Core course content viewer** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(course-reader)\`)
- Routes with dynamic `[courseid]` parameter:
  - `/course/[courseid]` -- Course overview (Composite view)
  - `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Topic view
  - `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Lab step-by-step reader
  - `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Talk/presentation viewer
  - `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Panel talk viewer
  - `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Note reader
  - `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Video viewer
  - `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Tutorial view
  - `/wall/[type]/[courseid]` -- Wall view (all items of a type)
  - `/search/[courseid]` -- In-course search
  - `/llm/[courseid]` -- LLM docs page (llms.txt convention)
  - `/time/[courseid]` -- Analytics/time tracking view

**`(live)` -- Real-time presence** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(live)\`)
- `/catalogue` -- Global course catalogue
- `/live/[courseid]` -- Live view showing online students, daily/weekly/monthly activity

**`(auth)` -- Authentication** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(auth)\`)
- `/auth` and `/auth/[courseid]` -- GitHub OAuth sign-in flow

**Every route has `export const ssr = false`** -- the app is entirely client-side rendered.

### 3. Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology | Version |
|-------|-----------|---------|
| **Framework** | SvelteKit | ^2.64.0 |
| **UI Framework** | Svelte 5 | ^5.56.3 (uses runes: `$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`, `$props`) |
| **Build Tool** | Vite | ^8.0.16 |
| **Language** | TypeScript | ^6.0.3 |
| **CSS Framework** | Tailwind CSS v4 | ^4.3.0 |
| **UI Components** | Skeleton (Svelte) | ^4.15.2 (`@skeletonlabs/skeleton-svelte`) |
| **Backend/BaaS** | Supabase | ^2.108.0 (`@supabase/supabase-js`) |
| **Auth** | Auth.js (SvelteKit) | 1.11.2 (`@auth/sveltekit`) with GitHub provider |
| **Real-time** | PartyKit/PartySocket | ^1.1.19 (WebSocket-based presence) |
| **Icons** | Iconify (Svelte) | ^5.2.1 |
| **Markdown** | Shiki (syntax highlighting) | ^4.2.0 |
| **PDF** | pdfjs-dist | ^6.0.227 |
| **Adapter** | `@sveltejs/adapter-auto` | ^7.0.1 (also has `adapter-netlify` ^6.0.4 available) |

### 4. Key Dependencies

**External published packages from JSR:**
```
"@tutors/tutors-model-lib": "npm:@jsr/tutors__tutors-model-lib@^5.0.0"
"@tutors/tutors-time-lib": "npm:@jsr/tutors__tutors-time-lib@^5.0.3"
```
These are the core domain model libraries published on JSR (Deno's package registry), consumed via `.npmrc` with `@jsr:registry=https://npm.jsr.io`. They provide:
- `tutors-model-lib`: Course, Lo, Lab, Note, Topic, Talk, Tutorial, Composite, Archive types; tree flattening, filtering, MD-to-HTML conversion, search functions, calendar initialization
- `tutors-time-lib`: Supabase initialization and time tracking utilities

**Other notable dependencies:**
- `jheat.js` (^5.2.0) -- heatmap visualization
- `file-saver` (^2.0.5) -- client-side file downloads
- `shiki-transformer-copy-button` (^0.0.6) -- copy buttons on code blocks

**Dependency freshness:** The versions listed are aggressively up-to-date (TypeScript 6.x, Vite 8.x, Svelte 5.56). The package was last updated on 2026-06-09.

### 5. Code Patterns

**Service Pattern:** The app uses a flat service-object pattern (not classes, not stores). Services are plain TypeScript objects with methods, exported as singletons:
- `courseService` -- course loading, caching, content resolution
- `tutorsConnectService` -- auth, user profile, analytics lifecycle
- `presenceService` -- WebSocket presence via PartyKit
- `liveService` -- global/course-level live monitoring
- `analyticsService` -- Supabase-backed learning analytics
- `catalogueService` -- course catalogue queries
- `markdownService` -- MD-to-HTML with Shiki highlighting
- `themeService` -- theme switching, icons, layout preferences

**State Management:** Uses Svelte 5 runes exclusively. A custom `rune<T>()` helper at `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts` wraps `$state()` into a `{ value }` getter/setter pattern. Global state atoms include `currentCourse`, `currentLo`, `tutorsId`, `currentLabStepIndex`, `courseProtocol`, `hideMainNavigator`, `animationDelay`, and `adobeLoaded`.

**Component Organization:**
- `src/lib/ui/components/` -- shared atoms (Icon, Image, Menu, Sidebar, etc.)
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/` -- content renderers (Lab, Note, Video, TalkClient, TalkAdobe, TalkMozilla, Podcast, Calendar)
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/` -- layout components (Card, Cards, Panels, Units, Wall)
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/` -- structural components (Composite, Context, CourseContext, LoContext, LoContextTree, LoReference)
- `src/lib/ui/navigators/` -- navigation (MainNavigator, SecondaryNavigator, Breadcrumbs, various indicator buttons)
- `src/lib/ui/time/` -- time/analytics views (Catalogue, Course, Students, StudentCard, etc.)

**Data Flow:** SvelteKit `+page.ts` load functions call `courseService.readCourse()` / `readLab()` / `readLo()` etc., which fetch `tutors.json` from Netlify-hosted course sites, then pass data down to page components as `data` props.

**Language:** 100% TypeScript. Files use the `.svelte.ts` extension for files containing Svelte rune syntax (a Svelte 5 convention). Components use `lang="ts"` in script blocks.

### 6. Configuration

**TypeScript** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\tsconfig.json`): Extends SvelteKit-generated config. Strict mode enabled, `bundler` module resolution, `allowJs` and `checkJs` enabled.

**Vite** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\vite.config.ts`): Uses `sveltekit()` and Tailwind CSS v4 plugins. Defines `APP_VERSION` from package.json.

**Svelte** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\svelte.config.js`): Uses `vitePreprocess()`, `adapter-auto`, suppresses `state_referenced_locally` warnings.

**ESLint** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\eslint.config.js`): Flat config with `typescript-eslint`, `eslint-plugin-svelte`, and `prettier` integration.

**Prettier** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\.prettierrc`): No tabs, double quotes, no trailing commas, 180 char print width, Svelte and Tailwind CSS plugins.

**VS Code** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\.vscode\settings.json`): Prettier as default formatter, format on save/paste.

**Environment** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\.env.example`): Supports anonymous mode (`PUBLIC_ANON_MODE=TRUE`), GitHub OAuth keys, Supabase keys, PartyKit room URL, and a PDF key.

**MCP** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\.mcp.json`): Configured to use Tessl MCP server.

### 7. Testing Infrastructure

**There is no test infrastructure whatsoever.** No `.test.ts` or `.spec.ts` files exist anywhere. No test runner (vitest, jest, playwright) is configured. No test scripts in `package.json`. There are remote branches named `testing`, `testing_strategy`, `testing_strategy_refactor`, and `feature/testing-infrastructure`, suggesting testing was explored but never merged to main.

### 8. Custom Themes and Styling

The app has a sophisticated theming system:
- **Built-in themes:** tutors, classic, dyslexia, terminus, rose, cerberus, easter
- **Custom CSS themes** at `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\lib\services\themes\styles\`: tutors.css, classic.css, dyslexia.css, easter.css, prose-headings.css
- **Skeleton framework themes** imported: cerberus, terminus, rose
- **Icon libraries**: FluentIconLib (default), HeroIconLib, EasterIcons, FestiveIcons, HalloweenIcons, ValentineIcons
- **Special effects**: Festive theme triggers snowfall animation
- **Accessibility**: OpenDyslexic font included for the dyslexia theme; PlayfairDisplay for the classic theme; Inter loaded from Google Fonts

### 9. Last Modification Timeline

| Date | Area | Activity |
|------|------|----------|
| 2026-06-09 | Routes, lib | Most recent: scroll-to-top fix, package updates |
| 2026-06-08 | Routes, lib | Horizontal scroll bars, hide navigators for Panel Note |
| 2026-06-03 | lib | Fix: remove web links from loIndex |
| 2026-05-01-05 | lib, routes | Live view refactoring, student grouping, latest activity by time period |
| 2026-04-13-28 | lib | Sentiment feature: button, types, status field updates, sync fixes |
| 2026-04-27-28 | lib | Hide main navigator for labs, fix footer |
| 2023-12-06 | cli | Last modification to CLI tool (very stale, 2.5+ years old) |

### 10. CLI Tool

`D:\code\tutors-apps\cli\tutors-publish-npm\dist\index.js` is a compiled CLI tool (v4.2.0) that:
1. Looks for `course.md` in the current directory
2. Uses `@tutors/tutors-gen-lib` to parse and generate JSON
3. Outputs to a `json/` subdirectory
No source TypeScript is present; only the compiled `dist/index.js`.

### 11. Authentication & Data Flow

- **Auth:** GitHub OAuth via `@auth/sveltekit` with JWT strategy (1-year sessions). Server hook at `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\hooks.server.ts`.
- **Client hook** at `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\hooks.client.ts`: Initializes `tutors-time-lib` Supabase connection.
- **Root layout server** at `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\+layout.server.ts`: Extracts user session from `locals.auth()`.
- **Anonymous mode:** `PUBLIC_ANON_MODE=TRUE` disables all auth, analytics, and presence features.

### 12. Real-time Features

- **PartyKit/PartySocket** WebSocket connections for live presence
- Two channels: `tutors-all-course-access` (global) and per-`courseId` rooms
- **Supabase tables used:** `learning_records`, `calendar`, `tutors-connect-users`, `tutors-connect-latest`
- Presence data broadcasted when users navigate learning objects
- 30-second interval timer updates page counts for analytics

## Tutors-Apps Codebase Analysis

### 1. Project Structure

This is **not a monorepo with workspaces**. It is a single SvelteKit application at version **15.2.0**, named `"tutors"`. There are no npm/pnpm workspaces, no `packages/` directory, and no Turborepo or Lerna configuration.

**Top-level layout:**
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\` -- Main SvelteKit application source
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\cli\` -- A standalone CLI tool (`tutors-publish-npm`, compiled JS only, no source)
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\static\` -- Static assets (fonts, images, CSS)
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\.tessl\` -- Tessl AI tool documentation tiles (library docs cache)
- `D:\code\tutors-apps\.github\` -- Only CODEOWNERS and holopin.yml (no CI workflows)

**Total source code:** approximately 8,377 lines across all `.svelte` and `.ts` files.

**Git repository:** 3,225 total commits. The current branch is `feat/jupyter-notebook-support`. The upstream remote points at `tutors-sdk`. CODEOWNERS are `@edeleastar` and `@jouwdan`.

### 2. Application Architecture (SvelteKit Routes)

The app uses SvelteKit's **route groups** to organize three major sections:

**`(home)` -- Landing/Home page** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(home)\`)
- `+page.svelte` -- Shows a welcome banner, info, links, and a CourseList
- Sub-components: `CourseList.svelte`, `CourseVisitCard.svelte`, `Links.svelte`, `TutorsInfo.svelte`, `Welcome.svelte`

**`(course-reader)` -- Core course content viewer** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(course-reader)\`)
- Routes with dynamic `[courseid]` parameter:
  - `/course/[courseid]` -- Course overview (Composite view)
  - `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Topic view
  - `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Lab step-by-step reader
  - `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Talk/presentation viewer
  - `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Panel talk viewer
  - `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Note reader
  - `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Video viewer
  - `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` -- Tutorial view
  - `/wall/[type]/[courseid]` -- Wall view (all items of a type)
  - `/search/[courseid]` -- In-course search
  - `/llm/[courseid]` -- LLM docs page (llms.txt convention)
  - `/time/[courseid]` -- Analytics/time tracking view

**`(live)` -- Real-time presence** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(live)\`)
- `/catalogue` -- Global course catalogue
- `/live/[courseid]` -- Live view showing online students, daily/weekly/monthly activity

**`(auth)` -- Authentication** (`D:\code\tutors-apps\src\routes\(auth)\`)
- `/auth` and `/auth/[courseid]` -- GitHub OAuth sign-in flow

**Every route has `export const ssr = false`** -- the app is entirely client-side rendered.

### 5. Code Patterns

**Service Pattern:** The app uses a flat service-object pattern (not classes, not stores). Services are plain TypeScript objects with methods, exported as singletons:
- `courseService` -- course loading, caching, content resolution
- `tutorsConnectService` -- auth, user profile, analytics lifecycle
- `presenceService` -- WebSocket presence via PartyKit
- `liveService` -- global/course-level live monitoring
- `analyticsService` -- Supabase-backed learning analytics
- `catalogueService` -- course catalogue queries
- `markdownService` -- MD-to-HTML with Shiki highlighting
- `themeService` -- theme switching, icons, layout preferences

**State Management:** Uses Svelte 5 runes exclusively. A custom `rune<T>()` helper at `D:\code\tutors-apps\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts` wraps `$state()` into a `{ value }` getter/setter pattern. Global state atoms include `currentCourse`, `currentLo`, `tutorsId`, `currentLabStepIndex`, `courseProtocol`, `hideMainNavigator`, `animationDelay`, and `adobeLoaded`.

**Component Organization:**
- `src/lib/ui/components/` -- shared atoms (Icon, Image, Menu, Sidebar, etc.)
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/` -- content renderers (Lab, Note, Video, TalkClient, TalkAdobe, TalkMozilla, Podcast, Calendar)
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/` -- layout components (Card, Cards, Panels, Units, Wall)
- `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/structure/` -- structural components (Composite, Context, CourseContext, LoContext, LoContextTree, LoReference)
- `src/lib/ui/navigators/` -- navigation (MainNavigator, SecondaryNavigator, Breadcrumbs, various indicator buttons)
- `src/lib/ui/time/` -- time/analytics views (Catalogue, Course, Students, StudentCard, etc.)

**Data Flow:** SvelteKit `+page.ts` load functions call `courseService.readCourse()` / `readLab()` / `readLo()` etc., which fetch `tutors.json` from Netlify-hosted course sites, then pass data down to page components as `data` props.

**Language:** 100% TypeScript. Files use the `.svelte.ts` extension for files containing Svelte rune syntax (a Svelte 5 convention). Components use `lang="ts"` in script blocks.
